ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity light (ventral surface) to low-intensity dark (margins, tips, and basal markings) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity central ventral region. Low-intensity outer margins and distal tips. Distinct low-intensity horizontal banding at the peduncle insertion point. A single high-intensity focal spot on the trailing edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch, approximately 105 degrees, with moderate depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with higher amplitude on the left lobe, including a prominent jagged indentation midway to the tip. Right lobe exhibits lower-frequency, lower-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on both lobes, curving from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse, small, roughly circular high-intensity clusters (potential barnacle scars) distributed across the central light-colored area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 4-5 parallel, horizontal dark linear marks (rake marks) located centrally near the base of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep horizontal rake marks at the fluke base and a significant traumatic notch/irregularity on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ladder' pattern of dark horizontal markings at the junction where the fluke meets the peduncle.
